arrow_convention: TOWARD-motion vectors (U eastward, V northward); calm <0.5 m/s no arrow; no duplicate arrows — one source owns each pixel
coverage: Shared North American boundary config/north_america_bounds.json (lon -180..-15, lat 5..85, 3300x1600). Full rectangle; missing components never treated as calm.
fallback_note: GDPS 10m winds only where RRFS has a verified variable/coverage gap.
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT MODEL (analysis, GLWU + HRRR + RRFS-NA, GDPS fallback)
precedence: GLWU valid (Great Lakes water) > HRRR valid (its domain, GLWU not applicable) > RRFS-NA valid (elsewhere) > GDPS (verified gaps only) > transparent.
primary_source: NOAA RRFS North American output, 10m U/V (para feed until prod opens; hourly)
source_name: NOAA/NCEP GLWU v2.1 surface U/V (Great Lakes water) + HRRR 3km 10m U/V + RRFS North American 10m U/V + ECCC GDPS fallback
title: LIVE WIND — BEAUFORT SCALE
variable: UGRD/VGRD 10m/surface, m/s -> kt x1.94384 -> WMO Beaufort 0-12
